title: SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射~SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source
focus: SASE 自由電子雷射的增益、束流壓縮、單發診斷與 LCLS-II 超導升級~SASE gain, bunch compression, single-shot diagnostics and the LCLS-II superconducting upgrade
summary: 以 SLAC 的 LCLS 為對象：常溫銅直線加速器以 120 Hz 提供 13.6 GeV 電子，在 112 m 波盪器中以自放大自發輻射（SASE）產生 1.5 Å 的飛秒 X 光脈衝；本課推導 Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和功率，拆解光陰極注入、束流壓縮與雷射加熱器，再把單發診斷、脈衝統計與 LCLS-II 的 4 GeV 超導連續波直線加速器（最高 1 MHz）整合成可驗收的工程邏輯。~Taking SLAC's LCLS: a normal-conducting copper linac delivers 13.6 GeV electrons at 120 Hz, and a 112 m undulator produces femtosecond 1.5 Å X-ray pulses by self-amplified spontaneous emission (SASE). The course derives the Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation power, works through the photoinjector, bunch compression and laser heater, then integrates single-shot diagnostics, pulse statistics and the LCLS-II 4 GeV superconducting continuous-wave linac (up to 1 MHz) into an acceptable engineering logic.

units.anchor: 銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）~Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)
units.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界~System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration
units.mechanism: LCLS 使用 SLAC 3 km 直線加速器的最後 1 km：2.856 GHz 的銅加速結構以約 17 MV/m 把電子推到 13.6 GeV，但銅壁的射頻損耗極大，只能以微秒級脈衝、120 Hz 重複率運轉。LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 裝入 1.3 GHz 鈮超導加速模組，在 2 K 下壁損耗低了五個數量級以上，可以連續波運轉，把重複率推到 1 MHz。兩種直線加速器共用同一個波盪器大廳，重複率、束流功率與光學熱負載因此差了四個數量級。~LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz. LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz niobium superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel, where wall losses at 2 K are more than five orders of magnitude lower, allowing continuous-wave operation and a repetition rate up to 1 MHz. Both linacs feed the same undulator hall, so repetition rate, beam power and optics heat load differ by four orders of magnitude.
units.model: 銅結構壁損耗功率密度 P/L = E²/r_s：E = 17 MV/m、分路阻抗 r_s = 53 MΩ/m 得 (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m，只能靠 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ 的工作比把平均降到約 650 W/m。超導腔以 Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ 運轉：V = 16.6 MV、R/Q = 1036 Ω 時 P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W（2 K，連續波），單腔差了六個數量級。~Copper wall-loss density P/L = E²/r_s: with E = 17 MV/m and shunt impedance r_s = 53 MΩ/m, (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m, so only a duty factor of 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ brings the average down to about 650 W/m. A superconducting cavity at Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ with V = 16.6 MV and R/Q = 1036 Ω dissipates P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W at 2 K in continuous wave, six orders of magnitude less per cavity.
units.verify: 以能譜儀（彎轉磁鐵加螢幕）量兩條直線加速器末端的束流能量與能散；以射頻功率計與量熱法比對銅結構的脈衝壁損與超導腔的 2 K 動態熱負載；用束流電荷監視器乘重複率核對平均束流功率，確認機器保護系統的設定門檻。~Measure beam energy and energy spread at the end of each linac with a spectrometer (bend plus screen); compare copper pulsed wall loss and superconducting 2 K dynamic heat load using RF power meters and calorimetry; and check the average beam power from charge monitors times repetition rate to confirm the machine-protection thresholds.
units.failure: 若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現；反過來把超導腔的連續波負載估成脈衝模式，2 K 低溫系統在數分鐘內失壓。~Connecting 120 Hz-era optics and detectors directly to a 1 MHz beam raises average power from watts to hundreds of watts, and mirror thermal bumps and detector saturation appear at once; conversely, estimating the superconducting cavities' CW load as if pulsed lets the 2 K cryogenic system lose pressure within minutes.
units.misconception: 銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。~A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling.

units.anchor: 112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益~112 m undulator and SASE gain
units.title: Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和~Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation
units.mechanism: 在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。成長率由 Pierce 參數 ρ 決定：ρ 由峰值電流、電子束尺寸、K 值與能量共同給出，典型只有 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級。功率每隔一個增益長度 L_g 增加 e 倍，約 20 個 L_g 後飽和；飽和功率約為 ρ 乘以電子束功率，頻寬也約為 ρ。LCLS 用 33 段共 112 m 的固定間隙波盪器就是為了在 8 keV 附近確保飽和。~Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE. The growth rate is set by the Pierce parameter ρ, which combines peak current, beam size, K and energy and is typically only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³. Power grows by e every gain length L_g and saturates after about 20 L_g; the saturated power is about ρ times the electron-beam power and the bandwidth is also about ρ. LCLS used 33 fixed-gap segments totalling 112 m precisely to guarantee saturation near 8 keV.
units.model: 13.6 GeV（γ = 26 615）、I = 3 kA、K = 3.5、λ_u = 30 mm、σ_x = 30 µm：λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å（8.2 keV）。ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3)，I_A = 17 kA、[JJ] = 0.74、k_u = 209 m⁻¹，得 ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴。L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m，飽和長度約 20L_g ≈ 60 m；P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW，30 fs 脈衝約 0.6 mJ，頻寬約 ρ ≈ 3.8 eV。數值顯示增益長度決定波盪器總長度，電子束發射度或能散不足時，飽和長度會明顯延長甚至無法飽和。~At 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm: λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å (8.2 keV). ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3) with I_A = 17 kA, [JJ] = 0.74 and k_u = 209 m⁻¹ gives ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴. L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m, so saturation takes about 20L_g ≈ 60 m; P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW, about 0.6 mJ in a 30 fs pulse, with bandwidth about ρ ≈ 3.8 eV. The numbers show that the gain length sets total undulator length; if emittance or energy spread is poor, saturation moves much further downstream or never occurs.
units.verify: 量增益曲線：依序把波盪器段的軌道踢開（或打開間隙）讓有效長度變短，記錄氣體偵測器的脈衝能量對長度的關係，對指數段取對數斜率得 L_g，與 3.0 m 比較，並確認曲線在 60 到 80 m 後轉平；再以單發光譜儀量頻寬核對 ρ。~Measure the gain curve: kick the beam out of successive undulator segments (or open their gaps) to shorten the effective length, record gas-detector pulse energy versus length, take the log slope of the exponential region to get L_g and compare with 3.0 m, and confirm the curve flattens after 60 to 80 m; then check ρ from the bandwidth on a single-shot spectrometer.
units.failure: 能散若因壓縮過程的微束團不穩定而升到超過 ρ，增益長度拉長數倍，112 m 走完仍未飽和，脈衝能量掉一個數量級且逐發抖動劇烈；問題出在直線加速器，波盪器本身完全正常。~If energy spread rises above ρ through microbunching instability during compression, the gain length stretches several times, the beam leaves 112 m still unsaturated, pulse energy drops an order of magnitude and shot-to-shot jitter explodes; the fault lies in the linac while the undulator itself is perfectly fine.
units.misconception: 自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。~FEL output power is proportional to undulator length.

units.anchor: 固定間隙波盪器段（λ_u = 30 mm，K = 3.5）~Fixed-gap undulator segments (λ_u = 30 mm, K = 3.5)
units.title: 波盪器 K 值公差、相位與溫控~Undulator K tolerance, phasing and temperature control
units.mechanism: SASE 的共振條件要求整段波盪器的 K 值一致到 ρ 的量級，否則不同段輻射的波長錯開、增益中斷。LCLS 波盪器以 NdFeB 永磁混合磁列組成，K 以微調磁極間隙的斜置機構校正；相鄰段之間的相位整合器（phase shifter）讓電子與光在段間漂移區保持同相；由於 NdFeB 剩磁隨溫度約 −0.1 %/K 變化，波盪器大廳的溫度穩定度直接變成 K 的穩定度。~The SASE resonance requires K to be uniform along the whole undulator to the order of ρ, otherwise the segments radiate at different wavelengths and the gain breaks. LCLS undulators are hybrid NdFeB arrays whose K is trimmed by a mechanism that slightly cants the gap; phase shifters between segments keep electrons and light in phase across the drift sections; and because NdFeB remanence changes by about −0.1 %/K, the undulator-hall temperature stability becomes the K stability.
units.model: 公差 ΔK/K ≲ ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴：K = 3.5 時 ΔK ≈ 1.6×10⁻³。B₀ = K/(0.934·λ_u[cm]) = 3.5/(0.934×3.0) ≈ 1.25 T，ΔB/B 同為 4.6×10⁻⁴；以 −1×10⁻³/K 的溫度係數換算，溫度必須穩定在約 0.5 K 以內，實務上以 ±0.1 K 控溫留餘裕。段間相位：漂移段 Δz 內電子相對光滑移 Δz/(2γ²) 的距離，要以相位整合器補到 λ 的整數倍。~Tolerance ΔK/K ≲ ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴: at K = 3.5, ΔK ≈ 1.6×10⁻³. B₀ = K/(0.934·λ_u[cm]) = 3.5/(0.934×3.0) ≈ 1.25 T, and ΔB/B is the same 4.6×10⁻⁴; with a −1×10⁻³/K temperature coefficient the temperature must hold within about 0.5 K, and in practice ±0.1 K control leaves margin. Between segments the electrons slip behind the light by Δz/(2γ²) over a drift Δz, which the phase shifter must trim to an integer number of wavelengths.
units.verify: 每段在磁量測台用霍爾探針與移動線圈量 K 與相位誤差，建立 K 對溫度與斜置量的查表；裝機後用束流做 K 掃描：逐段改變斜置量並量單發光譜的中心波長，使各段共振波長對齊到 10⁻⁴；長期監看大廳溫度與脈衝能量的相關性。~Measure K and phase error of each segment with Hall probe and moving coil on the magnet bench and build the K-versus-temperature-and-cant table; after installation do beam-based K scans, changing each segment's cant while measuring the single-shot central wavelength until all segments resonate within 10⁻⁴; and track the correlation between hall temperature and pulse energy over time.
units.failure: 束流損失照射磁列造成輻射退磁，某幾段的 K 下降超過公差，該段輻射偏離共振，增益曲線在那裡出現平台；若未定期做 K 掃描，操作人員只看到脈衝能量逐月下滑而找不到原因。~Radiation demagnetisation from beam losses lowers K in a few segments beyond tolerance, those segments radiate off resonance and the gain curve shows a plateau there; without regular K scans operators only see pulse energy sliding month by month with no visible cause.
units.misconception: 波盪器是被動磁鐵，裝好以後不需要再校正。~An undulator is a passive magnet that needs no recalibration once installed.

units.anchor: 光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器~Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors
units.title: 注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定~Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability
units.mechanism: 高峰值電流來自壓縮：光陰極射頻槍產生約 250 pC、數十安培的束團，在直線加速器中以離峰相位加速得到能量啁啾，再經兩個磁性壓縮器（chicane）讓高能電子走短路徑追上低能電子，把長度壓縮約百倍到 3 kA。壓縮同時放大縱向密度調變與相干同步輻射（CSR）造成的微束團不穩定，所以在注入器加一台雷射加熱器，刻意把能散從幾 keV 提高到約 20 keV 以藍道阻尼抑制不穩定。~High peak current comes from compression: the photocathode RF gun produces about 250 pC at tens of amperes, off-crest acceleration imprints an energy chirp, and two magnetic chicanes let high-energy electrons take the shorter path and catch up with low-energy ones, compressing the length about a hundredfold to 3 kA. Compression also amplifies longitudinal density modulations and the coherent-synchrotron-radiation (CSR) driven microbunching instability, so a laser heater in the injector deliberately raises the energy spread from a few keV to about 20 keV to suppress it by Landau damping.
units.model: 槍出口 Q = 250 pC、I₀ = 30 A → 長度 τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps；目標 3 kA → τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs，壓縮比 C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100。壓縮條件 1/C = 1 + h·R₅₆：以 R₅₆ = −40 mm 的單級壓縮為例，C = 10 需啁啾 h = (1/C − 1)/R₅₆ = (0.1 − 1)/(−0.04 m) ≈ 22.5 m⁻¹，即每公尺束長 22.5 的相對能量斜率，兩級串聯得到 100 倍。雷射加熱器把切片能散從 3 keV 提到 20 keV，經 100 倍壓縮後仍只占 13.6 GeV 的 1.5×10⁻⁴，低於 ρ。~At the gun, Q = 250 pC at I₀ = 30 A gives a length τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps; the 3 kA target gives τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs, a compression factor C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100. The compression condition is 1/C = 1 + h·R₅₆: for one stage with R₅₆ = −40 mm, C = 10 needs a chirp h = (1/C − 1)/R₅₆ = (0.1 − 1)/(−0.04 m) ≈ 22.5 m⁻¹, a relative energy slope of 22.5 per metre of bunch, and two stages in series give 100. The laser heater raises the slice energy spread from 3 keV to 20 keV, which after hundredfold compression is still only 1.5×10⁻⁴ of 13.6 GeV, below ρ.
units.verify: 用橫向偏轉腔（transverse deflecting cavity）把時間座標映射到螢幕上量束團長度與切片能散，核對壓縮比與 83 fs；以相干輻射（CTR/CDR）功率監視器做壓縮回授；掃描雷射加熱器能量，觀察壓縮後的能譜是否從帶尖峰結構變為平滑，並找出使 FEL 脈衝能量最大的加熱量。~Map time onto a screen with a transverse deflecting cavity to measure bunch length and slice energy spread, checking the compression factor and the 83 fs; use a coherent-radiation (CTR/CDR) power monitor for compression feedback; scan the laser-heater energy and watch the post-compression energy spectrum change from spiky to smooth, finding the heating that maximises FEL pulse energy.
units.failure: 雷射加熱器關閉或能量不足時，微束團不穩定在壓縮後把能譜撕成鋸齒狀，切片能散超過 ρ，FEL 增益崩潰；過度加熱則能散本身超過 ρ，兩邊都輸出不足，只有在一個窄窗內才正常。~With the laser heater off or too weak, microbunching instability tears the post-compression energy spectrum into a sawtooth, slice energy spread exceeds ρ and FEL gain collapses; overheating makes the energy spread itself exceed ρ, so output falls on both sides and only a narrow window works.
units.misconception: 能散越小對自由電子雷射越好，所以應該完全避免加熱束流。~Smaller energy spread is always better for an FEL, so the beam should never be heated.

units.anchor: 氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具~Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool
units.title: 逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間~Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time
units.mechanism: SASE 是由雜訊啟動的隨機過程，每一發的能量、光譜與時間結構都不同，所以 LCLS 的診斷全部必須逐發記錄並與實驗資料同標籤。氣體偵測器以 X 光游離稀薄氣體並收集離子或電子電流，無損地量每發脈衝能量；彎晶單發光譜儀把頻譜展開到條狀偵測器上；時序工具以 X 光在薄膜上誘發的折射率跳變，用啁啾的光學脈衝把 X 光到達時間量到飛秒等級，事後把資料按真實延遲重新排序。~SASE starts from noise, so every shot differs in energy, spectrum and time structure, and all LCLS diagnostics must record shot by shot and share tags with the experiment data. Gas detectors ionise dilute gas with the X-rays and collect ion or electron current to measure pulse energy non-destructively; a bent-crystal single-shot spectrometer spreads the spectrum onto a strip detector; and the timing tool uses the X-ray-induced refractive-index step in a thin film, probed by a chirped optical pulse, to measure X-ray arrival time at the femtosecond level so data can be re-sorted by true delay afterwards.
units.model: 電子能量抖動 σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ 經共振條件 λ ∝ 1/γ² 變成光子能量抖動 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³，在 8.2 keV 為 8 eV，大於單發頻寬 3.8 eV，故非逐發量光譜就無法知道每發的能量。到達時間：直線加速器射頻相位抖動 0.1° 在 2.856 GHz 對應 0.1/360×350 ps ≈ 97 fs，經壓縮器轉成數十飛秒的到達時間抖動，與 30 fs 的脈衝同量級，所以時序工具是必要的。~Electron energy jitter σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ becomes, through the resonance λ ∝ 1/γ², a photon-energy jitter of 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³, that is 8 eV at 8.2 keV, larger than the 3.8 eV single-shot bandwidth, so the energy of each shot is unknown without a shot-by-shot spectrum. Arrival time: an RF phase jitter of 0.1° at 2.856 GHz corresponds to 0.1/360×350 ps ≈ 97 fs, which the compressors convert into tens of femtoseconds of arrival-time jitter, comparable with the 30 fs pulse, so the timing tool is indispensable.
units.verify: 以量熱計或標定過的光二極體在不同脈衝能量下標定氣體偵測器的線性度；用已知吸收邊（例如 Fe K 邊 7.112 keV）標定光譜儀的能量軸；對時序工具，掃描泵浦雷射延遲並確認量到的到達時間分佈與電子束能量抖動的相關性；所有診斷的時間戳記必須與資料擷取系統逐發對齊。~Calibrate gas-detector linearity against a calorimeter or calibrated photodiode over a range of pulse energies; calibrate the spectrometer energy axis with a known absorption edge such as the Fe K edge at 7.112 keV; for the timing tool, scan the pump-laser delay and confirm that the measured arrival-time distribution correlates with electron-energy jitter; and align every diagnostic's time stamp with the data-acquisition system shot by shot.
units.failure: 若實驗只用平均脈衝能量與名義延遲，泵浦-探測資料被 50 fs 的到達時間抖動塗抹，100 fs 的動力學訊號消失；更糟的是時間戳記錯位一發，整批資料與診斷配對錯誤而無法事後修正。~If an experiment uses only average pulse energy and nominal delay, 50 fs of arrival jitter smears the pump-probe data and a 100 fs dynamic signal disappears; worse, a one-shot offset in time stamps mispairs an entire run with its diagnostics beyond later repair.
units.misconception: 自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。~An FEL, like a conventional laser, emits identical pulses every shot.

units.anchor: 脈衝統計：模式數與能量抖動~Pulse statistics: mode count and energy fluctuation
units.title: SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動~SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation
units.mechanism: SASE 脈衝由許多彼此不相干的縱向模式（尖峰）組成，尖峰的持續時間約為同調時間，由頻寬 ρ 決定；脈衝能量的逐發相對抖動近似為 1/√M，M 是模式數。長脈衝含數十到上百個尖峰，抖動只有百分之十幾；把束團壓到只含幾個模式時，抖動升到接近 100%，這正是 LCLS 短脈衝模式必須搭配逐發診斷的統計根源，也是「單尖峰」模式產生完全相干脈衝的原理。~A SASE pulse consists of many mutually incoherent longitudinal modes (spikes); each spike lasts about one coherence time, set by the bandwidth ρ, and the shot-to-shot relative fluctuation of pulse energy is about 1/√M for M modes. A long pulse contains tens to a hundred spikes and fluctuates by only ten-odd percent; compressing the bunch to a few modes drives the fluctuation toward 100%, which is the statistical reason LCLS short-pulse modes need shot-by-shot diagnostics, and also the principle behind single-spike modes that yield fully coherent pulses.
units.model: 模式數 M ≈ ρ·ω·T/(2π)：8.2 keV 時 ω = 2πc/λ = 1.25×10¹⁹ rad/s，ρ = 4.6×10⁻⁴，脈衝全寬 T = 70 fs → M ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴×1.25×10¹⁹×70×10⁻¹⁵/6.28 ≈ 64，能量抖動 ≈ 1/√64 ≈ 12%。T = 5 fs 時 M ≈ 4.6，抖動 ≈ 47%；M = 1 時抖動 100%。同調時間 τ_c ≈ 2π/(ρω) ≈ 1.1 fs，對應合作長度 λ/(4π√3ρ) ≈ 15 nm。~Mode count M ≈ ρ·ω·T/(2π): at 8.2 keV, ω = 2πc/λ = 1.25×10¹⁹ rad/s, ρ = 4.6×10⁻⁴ and full pulse length T = 70 fs give M ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴×1.25×10¹⁹×70×10⁻¹⁵/6.28 ≈ 64, so energy fluctuation ≈ 1/√64 ≈ 12%. For T = 5 fs, M ≈ 4.6 and fluctuation ≈ 47%; for M = 1 it is 100%. The coherence time τ_c ≈ 2π/(ρω) ≈ 1.1 fs corresponds to a cooperation length λ/(4π√3ρ) ≈ 15 nm.
units.verify: 從氣體偵測器累積數千發脈衝能量做直方圖，擬合伽瑪分佈取得 M，與 ρωT/2π 的估計比較；用單發光譜儀數尖峰數目與平均尖峰寬度核對同調時間；改變束團電荷或壓縮量，確認 M 隨脈衝長度線性變化。~Histogram several thousand gas-detector pulse energies, fit a gamma distribution to extract M and compare with the ρωT/2π estimate; count spikes and their mean width on the single-shot spectrometer to check the coherence time; and vary bunch charge or compression to confirm that M scales linearly with pulse length.
units.failure: 把 SASE 的統計抖動誤當成機器故障而反覆調整直線加速器，反而引入真正的漂移；或者反過來把直線加速器的慢漂移誤當成 SASE 統計而不處理，兩種誤判都來自沒有先用直方圖分離隨機與系統成分。~Mistaking SASE statistical fluctuation for a machine fault and repeatedly retuning the linac introduces real drift; conversely, dismissing a slow linac drift as SASE statistics leaves it untreated. Both misjudgements come from not first separating random and systematic components with a histogram.
units.misconception: 脈衝能量抖動大一定代表加速器不穩定。~Large pulse-energy fluctuation always means the accelerator is unstable.

units.anchor: 超導加速模組串與 2 K 低溫站~Cryomodule string and the 2 K cryoplant
units.title: LCLS-II 超導直線加速器整合~LCLS-II superconducting linac integration
units.mechanism: LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 安裝 1.3 GHz 的 TESLA 型超導加速模組（每模組 8 個九腔鈮腔，另加 3.9 GHz 線性化模組），以約 16 MV/m 的連續波梯度把電子加速到 4 GeV；腔體以氮摻雜製程把 Q₀ 提高到 2.7×10¹⁰ 以壓低 2 K 熱負載。模組由 Fermilab 與 Jefferson Lab 組裝、測試後運到 SLAC 串接；2 K 低溫站的容量由所有腔體的動態損耗加靜態漏熱決定，再乘上 2 K 制冷的效率。~LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz TESLA-type superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel (eight nine-cell niobium cavities per module, plus 3.9 GHz linearising modules), accelerating electrons to 4 GeV at a continuous-wave gradient of about 16 MV/m; nitrogen doping raises the cavity Q₀ to 2.7×10¹⁰ to limit the 2 K heat load. The modules were assembled and tested at Fermilab and Jefferson Lab and then strung together at SLAC; the 2 K cryoplant capacity follows from the dynamic loss of all cavities plus static heat leak, multiplied by the efficiency of 2 K refrigeration.
units.model: 35 個 1.3 GHz 模組×8 腔 = 280 腔，每腔 1.038 m、16 MV/m → 單腔 16.6 MV，總能量 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV，運轉 4 GeV 留餘裕。每腔動態損耗 P = V²/((R/Q)Q₀) ≈ 9.9 W（連續波），280 腔 ≈ 2.8 kW（2 K）；2 K 制冷以每瓦約 800 W 的壁上電力（教學假設）換算，低溫站需約 2.2 MW 的電力，加上靜態漏熱後需要 4 kW 等級的 2 K 容量。~35 modules at 1.3 GHz × 8 cavities = 280 cavities; each 1.038 m at 16 MV/m gives 16.6 MV per cavity and 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV in total, leaving margin for 4 GeV operation. Dynamic loss per cavity P = V²/((R/Q)Q₀) ≈ 9.9 W in continuous wave, about 2.8 kW at 2 K for 280 cavities; at roughly 800 W of wall-plug power per watt at 2 K (teaching assumption) the cryoplant draws about 2.2 MW, and with static heat leak a 2 K capacity of the 4 kW class is needed.
units.verify: 每個模組在組裝實驗室做低溫測試：量各腔的 Q₀ 對梯度曲線與場發射起始點，記錄 2 K 熱負載；串接後以量熱法（氦質量流量與焓差）量整條直線加速器的 2 K 總熱負載，與 280 腔的估算比較；以能譜儀驗證 4 GeV 與能散，並做 Lorentz 力失諧與微音效應（microphonics）的頻譜量測確認低階射頻控制餘裕。~Cold-test every module in the assembly laboratory: measure each cavity's Q₀ versus gradient and the field-emission onset and record the 2 K heat load; after stringing, measure the whole linac's 2 K load calorimetrically (helium mass flow times enthalpy difference) against the 280-cavity estimate; verify 4 GeV and energy spread with a spectrometer, and measure Lorentz-force detuning and microphonics spectra to confirm low-level RF control margin.
units.failure: 少數腔體在運轉中因場發射或多次 quench 讓 Q₀ 掉到 1×10¹⁰，單腔損耗升到 27 W，整串的 2 K 負載超過低溫站容量，必須降梯度運轉，能量達不到 4 GeV，波盪器只好開大間隙而縮小光子能量範圍。~If a few cavities lose Q₀ to 1×10¹⁰ through field emission or repeated quenches, their loss rises to 27 W each, the string's 2 K load exceeds the cryoplant, gradients must be lowered, 4 GeV is no longer reached, and undulators must open their gaps, shrinking the photon-energy range.
units.misconception: 超導腔沒有電阻，所以 2 K 下完全不產生熱。~Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so they produce no heat at 2 K.

units.anchor: 機器保護系統與使用者交付規格~Machine protection and user-delivery specification
units.title: 高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收~Machine protection and acceptance at high average power
units.mechanism: 1 MHz 連續波束流的平均功率達數百千瓦，任何導向錯誤都會在毫秒內熔穿真空腔，所以機器保護系統（MPS）必須以束流損失監視器、電流差分與溫度感測在百微秒內切斷注入器雷射。使用者驗收規格則包含光子能量範圍、脈衝能量、到達時間抖動、重複率與可用度；每一項都要綁定運轉模式（電荷、壓縮、波盪器設定），因為同一台機器在不同模式下的性能差異很大。~A 1 MHz continuous-wave beam carries hundreds of kilowatts of average power, and any steering error would melt through a chamber within milliseconds, so the machine protection system (MPS) must cut the injector laser within about a hundred microseconds using beam-loss monitors, current differencing and temperature sensors. The user-acceptance specification covers photon-energy range, pulse energy, arrival-time jitter, repetition rate and availability, each bound to an operating mode (charge, compression, undulator settings) because the same machine performs very differently across modes.
units.model: 平均束流功率 P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW。若導向錯誤把束流集中在 1 mm² 的鋁腔壁上，100 µs 內沉積 40 J，足以把該體積加熱數千度；MPS 的反應時間必須遠小於此。光子端：100 µJ×1 MHz = 100 W 平均功率落在第一面鏡子，與 120 Hz 時代 2 mJ×120 Hz = 0.24 W 相比高 400 倍，鏡面必須水冷並控制熱斜率誤差。~Average beam power P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW. A steering error concentrating the beam on 1 mm² of aluminium chamber wall deposits 40 J within 100 µs, enough to heat that volume by thousands of degrees, so the MPS reaction must be far shorter. On the photon side, 100 µJ×1 MHz = 100 W of average power lands on the first mirror, 400 times the 2 mJ×120 Hz = 0.24 W of the 120 Hz era, so mirrors must be water-cooled with controlled thermal slope error.
units.verify: 以可控的小幅導向錯誤在低重複率下測試 MPS 的觸發門檻與反應時間；用量熱法驗證束流吸收器與第一面鏡的熱負載和溫升；在每一種交付模式下量脈衝能量直方圖、光譜與到達時間抖動並寫入規格表；以一段時間的運轉紀錄計算可用度與平均故障間隔。~Test MPS thresholds and reaction time with controlled small steering errors at low repetition rate; verify the heat load and temperature rise of beam absorbers and the first mirror calorimetrically; in every delivery mode measure the pulse-energy histogram, spectrum and arrival-time jitter and enter them in the specification table; and compute availability and mean time between failures from a period of operating logs.
units.failure: 把 120 Hz 時代驗收的鏡面與光闌直接用於 1 MHz，熱凸起把聚焦斑放大數倍且位置漂移，實驗靈敏度下降；若 MPS 門檻依 120 Hz 的損失設定，連續波下的慢損失不會觸發而長期活化元件，維修人員承受不必要的劑量。~Reusing mirrors and masks accepted in the 120 Hz era at 1 MHz lets thermal bumps enlarge the focal spot several times and drift its position, degrading experimental sensitivity; if MPS thresholds follow 120 Hz loss levels, slow CW losses never trip and components are activated over time, exposing maintenance staff to needless dose.
units.misconception: 機器保護系統只在束流完全丟失時才需要動作。~Machine protection only needs to act when the beam is completely lost.

example: SASE 增益練習：取 LCLS 硬 X 光模式 E = 13.6 GeV（γ = 26 615）、峰值電流 I = 3 kA、K = 3.5、λ_u = 30 mm、σ_x = 30 µm。共振波長 λ = 0.030×(1+6.125)/(2×7.08×10⁸) ≈ 1.51×10⁻¹⁰ m，即 8.2 keV。Pierce 參數 ρ = [(1/16)(3000/17 045)(3.5²×0.74²)/(26 615³×(30×10⁻⁶)²×209²)]^(1/3) ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴。增益長度 L_g = 0.030/(4π×1.732×4.6×10⁻⁴) ≈ 3.0 m，飽和長度約 20L_g ≈ 60 m，112 m 的波盪器留有餘裕。飽和功率 P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6×10⁹×3000 ≈ 1.9×10¹⁰ W，30 fs 脈衝能量約 0.57 mJ；頻寬 ≈ ρ×8.2 keV ≈ 3.8 eV；70 fs 全寬脈衝的模式數 M ≈ ρωT/2π ≈ 64，逐發能量抖動約 12%。若歸一化發射度 0.4 µm，幾何發射度 0.4×10⁻⁶/26 615 ≈ 15 pm，略大於 λ/4π ≈ 12 pm，接近繞射極限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~SASE gain exercise: take the LCLS hard X-ray mode with E = 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), peak current I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm. The resonant wavelength is λ = 0.030×(1+6.125)/(2×7.08×10⁸) ≈ 1.51×10⁻¹⁰ m, that is 8.2 keV. The Pierce parameter ρ = [(1/16)(3000/17 045)(3.5²×0.74²)/(26 615³×(30×10⁻⁶)²×209²)]^(1/3) ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴. Gain length L_g = 0.030/(4π×1.732×4.6×10⁻⁴) ≈ 3.0 m, saturation after about 20L_g ≈ 60 m, so the 112 m undulator has margin. Saturated power P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6×10⁹×3000 ≈ 1.9×10¹⁰ W, about 0.57 mJ in a 30 fs pulse; bandwidth ≈ ρ×8.2 keV ≈ 3.8 eV; a 70 fs full-width pulse holds M ≈ ρωT/2π ≈ 64 modes with about 12% shot-to-shot energy fluctuation. With a normalised emittance of 0.4 µm the geometric emittance is 0.4×10⁻⁶/26 615 ≈ 15 pm, slightly above λ/4π ≈ 12 pm, close to the diffraction limit. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
history: SLAC 的 3 km 直線加速器於 1966 年啟用，原為高能物理設施；1992 年 Pellegrini 等人提出用其最後一段驅動 X 光自由電子雷射，LCLS 於 2006 至 2009 年建成，2009 年 4 月以 1.5 Å 首次出光，成為全球第一座硬 X 光自由電子雷射，重複率 120 Hz。LCLS-II 在隧道前段加裝 4 GeV 超導連續波直線加速器與兩支可變間隙波盪器，2023 年 9 月首次出光，重複率可達 1 MHz；LCLS-II-HE 將把超導直線加速器延伸到 8 GeV。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。~SLAC's 3 km linac began operation in 1966 as a high-energy-physics machine; in 1992 Pellegrini and colleagues proposed driving an X-ray free-electron laser with its final section, and LCLS was built from 2006 to 2009, first lasing at 1.5 Å in April 2009 as the world's first hard X-ray FEL at 120 Hz. LCLS-II added a 4 GeV superconducting continuous-wave linac in the front of the tunnel and two variable-gap undulators, achieving first light in September 2023 with repetition rates up to 1 MHz; LCLS-II-HE will extend the superconducting linac to 8 GeV. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.
